security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU rmw_mvip64 (target/riscv/csr.c:3844-3847), when mvien.VSSIE=0 and mideleg.SSIP=0, a write to mvip.VSSIP falls into alias_mask (mideleg|~mvien evaluates true) and is forwarded to rmw_mip, setting mip.SSIP. However the spec PR introduces per-field sw_write gating: `return (CSR[mvien].VSSIE == 1'b1) ? csr_value.VSSIP : 0` — writes when the corresponding mvien enable bit is 0 must be silently dropped, not aliased. Same applies to VSTIP/VSTIE and VSEIP/VSEIE pairs.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: mvip sw_write per-field mvien gating not enforced; mvip write aliased to mip when mvien bit is 0; rmw_mvip64 alias_mask mideleg|~mvien
security_spec.summary: mvip.VSSIP/VSTIP/VSEIP writes aliased to mip when mvien enable=0, bypassing spec per-field sw_write gate that requires enable=1 for writes to take effect
